preconditions.description: The input root must be an instance of TreeNode.
The number of nodes in the tree must be between 1 and 100.
The data of each node must be between 1 and 1000.
preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.data <= 1000 for node in traverse_tree(root))

postconditions.description: The output cloned_root must be an instance of TreeNode.
The cloned tree must be a separate instance from the original tree.
The data of each node in the cloned tree must match the data of the corresponding node in the original tree.
postconditions.expression: all(original_node.data == cloned_node.data for original_node, cloned_node in zip(traverse_tree(root), traverse_tree(cloned_root)))

postconditions.description: The random pointers in the cloned tree must match those in the original tree.
postconditions.expression: all(original_node.random == cloned_node.random for original_node, cloned_node in zip(traverse_tree(root), traverse_tree(cloned_root)))
